messages:
jamal: heads-up, EU warmpool GPU nodes failing to finish bootstrap after the iam conditional tweak this morning :rotating_light:
maria: saw that, first noticed a spike in node-join errors around 07:12 UTC
sre-anna: stacktrace in the agent logs shows KMS decrypt error + 403 from sts:AssumeRole
devin: can someone paste the exact policy change? i only saw a slack summary earlier
security-liz: i pushed a narrow conditional that requires source-vpc tag for KMS decrypt to reduce blast radius. it rolled at 07:05 UTC via pkg deploy.
jamal: that matches timeline. nodes in eu-west-1 don't have the new vpc tag yet (old onboarding flow), so decrypt fails and node aborts join.
maria: workaround possible: allow the existing keystore role for a short window or add an exception for the warmpool role?
security-liz: we can add a temporary exception, but prefer to avoid long-lived exceptions. recommend short allowlist for the warmpool role ARN for 30m.
devin: agreed. ops-bot can you open a quick rollback PR for the conditional or add allowlist?
ops-bot: ticket #INF-4572 created: "temp allowlist warmpool role for KMS decrypt". PR draft at https://git.internal/r/infra/policy/ps/89
sre-anna: impact report: ~120 nodes failed join attempts in last 20m, autoscaler queued ~40 extra launches (paying spot charges). no user-facing latency yet but internal capacity burn.
jamal: cost hit estimate? we threw a couple of on-demand fallbacks in us-east yesterday when capacity low; this might be similar but shorter window
maria: rough calc: 40 extra spot nodes * 2h average * $0.6/hr = ~$48. plus provisioning churn. not huge but if it persists it's bad.
devin: remediation plan: 1) add warmpool role allowlist in policy for 20m 2) backfill missing vpc-tags via onboarding job 3) add policy deploy rollback guard to hold for 15m in future
security-liz: i can push allowlist now. will also add a deploy-step to wait for quorum of node agents before flipping conditionals.
jamal: please DO that. also adding a fallback routing rule so requests from untagged nodes go to regional KMS proxy for now?
sre-anna: we have a proxy in eu, but it still needs decrypt privileges. allowlist covers that. i'll kick the tagging backfill job (onboarding-service/job/251) now.
maria: after allowlist is live i'll watch node-join metric and post thresholds.
ops-bot: policy change deployed (allowlist) at 07:48 UTC by security-liz.
maria: node-joins trending back up. warmpool healthy at 07:52 UTC.
devin: followups: add a Canary checklist for iam conditionals, document warmpool role exceptions, and add alert for KMS-decrypt 5m spike to paged channel.
security-liz: noted. i'll file follow-up RFC for conditional deploy cadence and a short human approval gate for infra-critical policies.
jamal: thanks everyone. postmortem-lite in #postmortems tomorrow, cc @sre-anna for metrics.
sre-anna: will extract join failure logs and token counts, will include cost delta.
maria: closing thread when postmortem link is up. :thumbsup:
